name: Raven Reader
description: In the reviewed Raven Reader snapshot, the production main process calls electron-updater's checkForUpdatesAndNotify and prompts before quitAndInstall after an update is downloaded. The available source does not independently establish the claimed notarization, hardened-runtime, or release-signing controls.
limitations: New default-branch snapshot; repository status and historical release artifacts were not treated as evidence of the original release's signing configuration.
